title: Garry R NDE 6802
content: My family was on a trip to visit friends in Carolina. I was nine at the time and my kid sister was four. Our friends lived in an older house that was being remodeled. Being the sort of child who loved to go exploring, I found an upstairs closet with a large hole in the floor that seemingly led to a secret room. I tried to climb down through the hole, slipped, and became stuck. My weight was pressing down on my diaphragm and my arms were pinned. I felt only a brief moment of panic and then very calmly and matter-of-factly passed out. As I passed out, I exited my body and found myself floating in the center of the room. I was aware of the entire room, my stuck body, and the surroundings within and without the house. I was also aware of a sort of shimmering fog that surrounded the area and that was growing more distinct and substantial by the moment. While I felt very calm and very peaceful, I was also aware of a sense of very real urgency in that, if I did not get help soon I would not be able to get back. I was aware of my sister playing outside in the yard with our friends and I moved out through the second story window and down into yard. I positioned myself just inches from my sister's face. I knew that I could not make any sound, and though I could hear my sister's thoughts, I could feel a resistance like a heavy wool blanket between us preventing me from communicating with her. Somehow, I knew to focus my attention in the mental equivalent of a shout in the hope that it would pierce that resistance. I directed all of my thought toward her in a yell for help. She suddenly ran toward the house. I returned to body and found my sister leading the adults into the room. They pulled me from the hole and I started breathing again.

out_of_body.vantage_other_detail: Floating in the center of the room; moved out through a second-story window down into the yard; positioned inches from sister's face.
out_of_body.separation_sensations_other: Brief panic followed by calm, peaceful, matter-of-fact passing out; sense of urgency about needing help to get back.

environment.environment_other_detail: A 'shimmering fog' surrounding the area, growing more distinct and substantial.

context.nde_cause_other_detail: Childhood accident: slipped while climbing down through a hole in an upstairs closet floor, became stuck with weight pressing on diaphragm; passed out and stopped breathing until rescued.

stage_sequence.elements_other_detail: Shimmering fog; telepathic attempt to communicate with sister; urgency about not being able to get back without help.
stage_sequence.sequence_variation_description: OBE in room, then moved outside to sister, then returned to body when help arrived; no tunnel/light/life review/boundary described.

unique_elements.nonstandard_elements: A perceived 'shimmering fog' surrounding the area; telepathic hearing of sister's thoughts with a felt 'heavy wool blanket' resistance to communication, overcome by a focused mental 'shout'.
unique_elements.notable_quotes: “I exited my body and found myself floating in the center of the room.” “I was also aware of a sort of shimmering fog that surrounded the area…” “I could hear my sister's thoughts… a resistance like a heavy wool blanket between us…”
